why: No major reviewer or authority answers this. The famous names (Verge, TechRadar, Popular Mechanics, WIRED, Good Housekeeping) are news or single-bundle deal posts, mostly on units far over $500; the one sub-$500 deal pairs a 1kWh station with a 45W panel the post itself says to skip for solar. Nearly every roundup ranks bare stations under $500 without panels. Only powersized.com addresses kits with price tracking, untested and not filtered to the budget. A focused page on sub-$500 station+panel bundles with current prices and a direct pick would stand out, just as our solar-kit page did.
